skills.node.dimensionalCatCables.technic.value: 5x as many Data Centers from Pocket Dimensions. 25% less Data Center production from Planets.

skills.node.doubleScienceTree.descriptio.value: Breakthroughs in CPU manufacturing allow your science bots to calculate twice as much data.

skills.node.economicRevolution.descripti.value: Self improving bots create a surge in economic progress.

skills.node.economicRevolution.technical.value: Multiplies Cash by 5 while you have at least 50% of bots assigned to Panel Production.

skills.node.endOfTheLine.description.value: Imagine a future where Assembly Lines stretch far into the horizon, bustling with the hum of robots tirelessly working. While this may sound like a productivity paradise, it also comes with a hefty price tag. Longer Assembly Lines mean an increased number of Bots, but as a result, they gobble up valuable real estate, chipping away at the already dwindling power of our planets.

skills.node.fragmentAssembly.description.value: As you begin to piece the fragments together, you manage to decipher ways to improve all of your buildings.

skills.node.fragmentAssembly.technical.value: If you have at least 4 other Fragment Skills assigned, triple the production of all Buildings.

skills.node.fusionReactors.technical.value: Boost Panel Production by 5x, reduce Cash income by 25%

skills.node.higgsBoson.technical.value: Boosts Cash gain by 10% for every Galaxy engulfed.

Counting sheep is such a breeze, Helps me fall asleep with ease, One by one they jump the fence, Takes me to dreamland in suspense.
White and fluffy, soft and neat, Lead me to slumber so sweet, Close my eyes, take a deep breath, Counting sheep, I meet my rest.
Over the hills and far away, Sheep are counting every day, A bedtime ritual, tried and true, Helping me and maybe you.

skills.node.parallelProcessing.descripti.value: One fine day in the middle of the night, 2 dead men got up to fight, back to back they faced each other, drew their swords and shot each other. Oh wait this is about processing.

skills.node.parallelProcessing.technical.value: Increase Server effectiveness by 5% for every log2(Servers).

skills.node.planetAssembly.description.value: So, planets are made out of matter, right? Well, so are Assembly Lines! Getting enough assembly lines together should create more planets. Don't ask why robots don't do the same.

skills.node.planetAssembly.technical.value: Gain Planets equal to log10(Assembly Lines).

skills.node.planetsTree.description.value: Through more efficient use of space and construction equipment, Data Center build time is halved.

skills.node.planetsTree.technical.value: Multiplies Planet Data Center production by 2.

skills.node.pocketAndroids.description.value: It was only a matter of time before your most trusted workers entered your pocket dimensions. The results are quite astonishing, be it they take time to be noticeable.

skills.node.pocketAndroids.technical.value: Over the course of an hour, Pocket Dimensions gain a production boost with the cap of 100x.

skills.node.pocketDimensions.description.value: Discovery of pocket dimensions allow multiple Data Centers to be placed in layers. Ya know, like Onions. Or is it more like a TARDIS?

skills.node.pocketDimensions.technical.value:
Produces Data Centers based on Log10(Worker Bots)

Starting at 10 Worker Bots, you gain 1 Data Center per second, this increases by 1 each time you multiply your Workers by 10.

skills.node.pocketMultiverse.description.value: Breakthroughs in Pocket technology allow ludicrous improvements.

skills.node.pocketMultiverse.technical.value: Pocket Protectors instead multiplies your Data Center production by log10(Scientists).

skills.node.pocketProtectors.description.value: Your scientists want in on this as well.

skills.node.pocketProtectors.technical.value: Increase Data Center production by log10(Scientists).

skills.node.powerOverwhelming.descriptio.value: Use Cash to boost Cash, is economic manipulation still frowned upon?

skills.node.powerUnderwhelming.descripti.value: Use Science to boost Science, how? We will never know.

skills.node.producedAsScienceTree.descri.value: Improved networking protocols increase your Scientists ability to work closely together, improving science yield greatly.

skills.node.producedAsScienceTree.techni.value: For every 1% of bots invested in science gain, +100% science production. Multiplicative with other upgrades, but not with itself.

skills.node.productionScaling.descriptio.value: You find a fragment of another universe. You use this knowledge to improve your entire production line, I wonder what other parts of this universe you can find?

skills.node.productionScaling.technical.value: Start the 1% bonus with the first purchased building after 90. Reduce that threshold by another 5 for every other assigned Fragment Skill.

skills.node.progressiveAssembly.descript.value: You find a fragment of another universe. You use this knowledge to improve your Assembly Lines, I wonder what other parts of this universe you can find?

skills.node.progressiveAssembly.technica.value: Assembly Lines produce 1.5x as much. Increase this bonus by 0.5x for every other assigned Fragment Skill.

skills.node.purityOfBody.description.value: You become one with your Bots, perfection on this scale never before seen.

skills.node.purityOfBody.technical.value: Multiply Bots by 1.25x for each unspent Skill Point, compounding exponentially.

skills.node.purityOfMind.description.value: WIth singular focus you clear your mind of all thoughts that don't include Cash or Science.

skills.node.purityOfMind.technical.value: Multiply Cash/Science by 1.5x for each unspent Skill Point, compounding exponentially.

skills.node.purityOfSEssence.description.value: You transcend beyond reality, consuming everything in your path you become one with the Universe.

skills.node.purityOfSEssence.technical.value: Multiply Everything by 1.42x for each unspent Skill Point, compounding exponentially.

skills.node.quantumComputing.description.value: Using the same old server line-up seriously dampers with your progress. By utilizing quantum mechanics, you can now have servers that are simultaneously on, off, and both, boosting their efficiency in ways you don't quite understand.

skills.node.quantumComputing.technical.value: Production of Data Centers from Pocket Dimensions is boosted by Log2(Rudimentry Singularity Production).

skills.node.reapers.description.value: Turn the filthy xeno scum into useful "voluntary" colonization and enslaving units.

skills.node.reapers.technical.value: Panel production multiplied by log2(Panels Decayed) / 10.

skills.node.regulatedAcademia.descriptio.value: You find a fragment of another universe. You use this knowledge to improve your Bots, I wonder what other parts of this universe you can find?

skills.node.regulatedAcademia.technical.value: Science and Cash Boost base is increased by 20%. Increase the base by 10% for every other assigned Fragment Skill.

skills.node.renegade.description.value: Fear is but a tool for the strong to make the weak be more productive. Red solar panels spread fear across your galaxies, forcing your population to pay more subsidies to you.

skills.node.renewableEnergy.description.value: Renewables surge in popularity leading you to focus on panel lifetime improvements.

skills.node.renewableEnergy.technical.value:
Starting at 10 million worker bots, panel lifetime increases by 10%. This increases by 10% each time you multiply your workers by 10.

lifetime *= 1 + 0.1 * log10(Workers / 1e6)

skills.node.repeatableResearch.descripti.value: Repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat.

skills.node.repeatableResearch.technical.value: Every research also reduces the cost of the research by the listed value (so Science Boost 300% and Cash Boost 250% means Science Boost costs 4x less and Cash Boost costs 3.5x less).

skills.node.rocketMania.description.value: Fly your Rocket from pad to pad and try not to crash!

skills.node.rocketMania.technical.value: Panels per second is multiplied by Log20(Panels Per Second)

skills.node.rudimentarySingularity.descr.value: Folding particles back in on themselves allow you to form the universes first singularities. Perhaps this technology could benefit your Data Centers somehow?

skills.node.rudimentarySingularity.techn.value:
Data Centers produce Servers based on Log2(Assembly Line Production) ^ Log10(Assembly Line Production).

Requires at least 1 production from AI Managers.

skills.node.saren.description.value: Utilize your overwhelming firepower (Daka daka) to enslave other spacefaring races. Humanity first!

skills.node.scientificDominance.descript.value: Shift your goals into the research sector with singular focus.

skills.node.scientificPlanets.descriptio.value: Teach some of your Scientists to discover planets for you.

skills.node.scientificPlanets.technical.value:
Produces Planets based on Log10(Science Bots)

Starting at 10 Science Bots, you gain 1 Planet per second, this increases by 1 each time you multiply your Scientists by 10.

skills.node.scientificRevolution.descrip.value: Self improving bots create a surge in scientific progress.

skills.node.scientificRevolution.technic.value: Multiplies Science by 5 while you have at least 50% of bots assigned to Science.

skills.node.serverTree.description.value: Learn to build taller server racks and better cooling. Servers can run twice as many managers.

skills.node.serverTree.technical.value: Multiplies Servers AI Manager production by 2.

skills.node.shellWorlds.description.value: Have you heard of matrioshka worlds? Basically worlds layered into worlds layered into worlds. This technique, other than extremely space efficient, allows planets to give birth to more planets based on how many planets exist.

skills.node.shepherd.description.value: You are not alone, in the endless expanse of space. Others share the same goal as you, and together you will act as a protector and guidance to all not yet spacefaring forms of life.

skills.node.shoulderSurgery.description.value: Transplanting these weird looking shoulders should be fine, right?

skills.node.shoulderSurgery.technical.value: Shoulders of the Fallen now also affect Pocket Dimensions.

skills.node.shouldersOfGiants.descriptio.value: You find an extinct civilization and learn from their mistakes.

skills.node.shouldersOfGiants.technical.value: Scientific Planets also produce Science Boosts.

skills.node.shouldersOfPrecursors.descri.value: The Shoulders of Precursors is a powerful artifact with the ability to multiply wealth and knowledge. It negates the effects of other wealth multipliers and also affects cash. This mysterious relic from a lost civilization is highly valuable and sought after. Its true potential remains unknown.

skills.node.shouldersOfPrecursors.techni.value:
Disable Cash Multipliers, Science Multipliers additionally affect Cash.

Mutually exclusive with Shoulders of the Enlightened.

skills.node.shouldersOfTheEnlightened.de.value: The "Shoulders of the Enlightened" are a pair of mysterious and powerful artifacts that grant immense knowledge and understanding to their bearer, along with the ability to generate great wealth.

skills.node.shouldersOfTheEnlightened.te.value: Scientific Planets also produces Cash Boosts. Mutually Exclusive with Shoulders of the Precursors.

skills.node.shouldersOfTheFallen.descrip.value: The Shoulders of the Fallen are a revered artifact said to have belonged to great leaders of a lost civilization. They possess the power to enhance Planet production, the extent of which is determined by the number of science boosts acquired. This makes the Shoulders a valuable addition to any empire seeking to increase its production and growth. The true nature and history of this powerful relic remains a mystery, but those who possess it are rumored to have an edge in their quest for expansion and prosperity.

skills.node.shouldersOfTheFallen.technic.value: Scientific Planets create additional Planets based on Log2(Science Boosts)

skills.node.shouldersOfTheRevolution.des.value: The "Shoulders of the Revolution" is a phrase that refers to a powerful financial system that harnesses the latest advancements in science to dramatically increase wealth. It is said to be built upon the innovations and insights of previous generations of thinkers, and it represents a new era of prosperity and progress for those who use it.

skills.node.shouldersOfTheRevolution.tec.value: Gain 1% additional Cash per Science Boost.

skills.node.solarBubbles.description.value: You noticed a significant efficiency potential. By introducing tiny condensed spheres (nicknamed bubbles) of solar energy, your panels in the pocket dimensions have something to do, resulting in a significant boost to production.

skills.node.solarBubbles.technical.value: Pocket Dimensions gain 1% production boost for every second of Panel Lifetime.

skills.node.startHereTree.description.value: Through improvements to core algorithms you improve the efficiency of your bots.

skills.node.stayingPower.description.value: Spending some extra time in a system lets you improve the efficiency of things.

skills.node.stayingPower.technical.value: Increase Assembly Line Bot production by 1% per second of Panel Lifetime

skills.node.stellarDominance.description.value: A price must be paid for greater profits.

skills.node.stellarDominance.technical.value: All Panel Lifetime x10. Cash / 100. Bots Sacrificed x100. May the stars have mercy.

skills.node.stellarImprovements.descript.value: You use AI to improve construction processes. New molecular structures allow you to use less materials in the process.

skills.node.stellarImprovements.technica.value: Divide Bots required for Stellar Sacrifices by 1000.

skills.node.stellarObliteration.descript.value: Obliterating even more Bots greatly improve the rate at which you generate artificial Planets, however this is costly.

skills.node.stellarObliteration.technica.value: Stellar Sacrifices Galaxies are 1000x better, however you divide your Cash, and Science by Stellar Galaxies.

skills.node.stellarSacrifices.descriptio.value: You decide to start utilizing the materials in your own bots to create additional planet sized structures for your empire.

skills.node.stellarSacrifices.technical.value:
Every second destroy Bots equal to Stars Surrounded and gain Planets equal to Log10(Stellar Galaxies Engulfed) ^ 2.

A stellar galaxy is just a normal galaxy with stellar modifiers added.

skills.node.superRadiantScattering.descr.value: Scattering... Something... Causes a perpetually increasing value to affect everything you touch.

skills.node.superRadiantScattering.techn.value: For each second this skill is assigned and the app is running, all production increases by 1% this scales additively, and resets on Infinity/Quantum Leap.

skills.node.superSwarm.description.value: Why not double the amount of panels per swarm?

skills.node.superSwarm.technical.value: Increase the 1% production gain after 100 purchases to 2%

skills.node.superchargedPower.descriptio.value: Supercharge your power grid, drastically improving the performance of your empire!

skills.node.superchargedPower.technical.value: Boosts all Buildings, Cash, and Science by 50%

skills.node.supernova.description.value: You discover a way to utilize supernovas to melt bots faster.

skills.node.supernova.technical.value: Stellar Sacrifices Galaxies are 1000x better. While Supernova is assigned, manually purchased buildings lose every production bonus including Avocados, the 50/100 milestones, Production Scaling, and all Swarm rates. Unassigning Supernova restores the complete manual-purchase layer.

skills.node.tasteOfPower.description.value: After getting your first taste of real power you crave more. Seek it out.

skills.node.tasteOfPower.technical.value: 50% stronger Assembly Lines, AI Managers, Servers, Data Centers, and Planets. 25% less Cash and Science.

skills.node.terraEculeo.description.value: Your planets are the biggest wheel of progress. They spin around and make more servers, they sure look like a spring in Denver.

skills.node.terraEculeo.technical.value: Bought Planets also count towards bought Servers.

skills.node.terraFirma.description.value: Focusing on more earthlike planets allows humanity to thrive, increasing the rate of progression.

skills.node.terraFirma.technical.value: Bought Planets also count towards Bought Data Centers.

skills.node.terraGloriae.description.value: "Glory to your planets". The new galactic mega corporation motto, that surprisingly reduces the cost of getting more planets. Maybe you should come out with more of them.

skills.node.terraGloriae.technical.value: Total Planets reduce the cost of bought Planets.

skills.node.terraInfirma.description.value: Okay, the description is a bit misleading. Your planets aren't weak nor crippled, they are just sanctuaries for the smaller and weaker members of your empire (your AI Managers, in this case).

skills.node.terraInfirma.technical.value: Bought Planets also count towards bought AI Managers.

skills.node.terraIrradiant.description.value: You aren't quite sure why, but every planet you manually spend resources to get shines bright like a diamond. It might have to do with bombing the planet afterwards with metric tons of diamonds.

skills.node.terraIrradiant.technical.value: Bought Planets now count Twelve Times.

skills.node.terraNova.description.value: Earth is threatened with extinction in the year 2149. The Shannon family transport themselves back a million years, where colonies of humans have a second chance to build a civilisation.

skills.node.terraNova.technical.value: Planet Boost effect also reduces the Cost of new Planets.

skills.node.terraNullius.description.value: There aren't any planets like yours. And that's because you are amazing! Also because each planet is filled to the brim with Assembly Lines, Managers, Servers and Data Centers.

skills.node.terraNullius.technical.value: Bought Planets also count towards bought Assembly Lines.

skills.node.terraformingProtocols.descri.value: You find a fragment of another universe. You use this knowledge to discover new Planets, I wonder what other parts of this universe you can find?

skills.node.terraformingProtocols.techni.value: Assemble an additional Planet per second. Get an additional Planet for every other assigned Fragment Skill.

skills.node.ultimateSwarm.description.value: Pushing the limits is what you do best.

skills.node.ultimateSwarm.technical.value: Increase the production multiplier from 3% to 5%

skills.node.unsuspiciousAlgorithms.descr.value: Lowering Suspicion allows... wait, wrong game.

skills.node.unsuspiciousAlgorithms.techn.value: Get 10x as many Servers from Rudimentary Singularity.

skills.node.versatileProductionTactics.d.value: Stuff happens, and your production layout is prepared for everything and anything. This allows for a flexible production boost, boosting the highest and the lowest layer of the dyson swarm.

skills.node.versatileProductionTactics.t.value: You now produce 50% more AI Managers. Additionally, after 100 Planets, Planets production boosted by 50%

skills.node.whatCouldHaveBeen.descriptio.value: Sick of imagining what could have been you decide to put your imagination into action.

skills.node.whatCouldHaveBeen.technical.value: Shoulders of Giants now additionally work off Pocket Dimensions.

skills.node.whatWillComeToPass.descripti.value: Death, life, death, life. An eternal loop of what will come to pass. Being prepared not only helps your psychology, but also your pocket dimensions.

skills.node.whatWillComeToPass.technical.value: Every bought Data Center gives a 1% boost to production of Data Centers.

skills.node.workerBoost.description.value: Additional worker bots can now be used as home assistants... At a cost of course!

skills.node.workerBoost.technical.value: For every 1% invested in Workers, +100% Cash production.

skills.node.workerEfficiencyTree.descrip.value: CPU upgrades allow your workers to operate additional arms, making them twice as effective.

skills.node.worthySacrifice.description.value: Worthy Sacrifice is a legendary trade-off, balancing panel longevity for efficient assembly. It requires bold leadership and a deep understanding of organizational values. A symbol of determination and strategic thinking, it is remembered as a tale of calculated risk-taking.

skills.node.worthySacrifice.technical.value: Panel Lifetime will be reduced by 50%, but Assembly Lines will be 5x as effective.

story.chapter-1.intro.value: As you stare down at your keyboard, the computer whirring in the background, an idea suddenly comes to you. You stand up and head over to your workbench... You begin working and quickly build a bot, it has two arms and hovers. Huh it works... You assign it to begin making solar panels and get to work on another.

story.chapter-1.part-2.value: Before long you have 10 bots, but this is quickly getting tiring. You set up an assembly line and write some code that lets it produce bots for you.

story.chapter-1.part-3.value: You're also going to need some power, so you launch some panels into space, and begin to sell off the excess power.

story.chapter-2.intro.value: You decide that manually building assembly lines is too much work, a few moments later you decide to design an AI that can manage the creation of assembly lines for you. Before long it's ready. You insert the module into a specialized bot and it whirrs to life quickly buzzing off to begin constructing more assembly lines.

story.chapter-2.part-2.value: You're starting to run out of space. You've set up a research division and created better AI that can collect the resources you need for your discoveries. But you need to create some servers to store all the data. Costly but worth it.

story.chapter-2.part-3.value: Before long your empire grows beyond anything you could ever have imagined. You've long since surrounded your first star with panels and it's time to begin thinking of expansion. You send out some probes and start looking for ideal systems to take over. In the meantime you expand your operation to other planets in the system.

story.chapter-3.intro.value: As you stare into a mirror one day, you are hit with the sudden realization of how long it's been. You design a method of extracting your consciousness and export it to an organic computer. With infinite life in your grasp you set out to explore the universe.

story.chapter-3.part-2.value: One day you come across some kind of anomaly, your curiosity gets the better of you. You head towards it and avocado into the murky mists.. Some writing begins to take shape and you catch a glimpse of a few words: Buffer overflow imminent... 41.9Qi/42.0Qi. The number ticks over and everything goes black...

story.chapter-3.part-2-stare.value: One day you come across some kind of anomaly, your curiosity gets the better of you. You head towards it and stare into the murky mists.. Some writing begins to take shape and you catch a glimpse of a few words: Buffer overflow imminent... 41.9Qi/42.0Qi. The number ticks over and everything goes black...

story.chapter-4.intro.value: You find yourself staring at your workbench, having just created your first bot...

story.chapter-4.part-10.value: 10 times.. The machine seems to be reaching its limits. Perhaps its best to focus on something new. You have noticed with each reset the anomaly has changed slightly. Perhaps it's time to focus on the secrets of the Universe.

story.chapter-4.part-2.value: You decide to take advantage of what you have learned. Infinity doesn't seem that long after all. Altering a couple of lines in the assembly line logic allows you to produce bots at twice the rate. However before long your previous experience with this reality slips from your mind as if it were a dream. "There has to be a way to remember more" you think to yourself as you set out to find the anomaly once more.

story.chapter-4.part-3.value: Remembering more is no easy feat and the multitimeline stuff takes its toll. You manage to triple the effect of your Managers, this bonus trickles down to your Assembly Lines too. You wonder if you can do better next time.

story.chapter-4.part-4.value: Remembering is getting easier. This time you Quadruple the power of your servers using information you intentionally acquired from the future. And set out to improve your Data Centers next.

story.chapter-4.part-5.value: Advanced spacial reasoning along with smaller server profiles allow you to fit far more power in the same space. Five times more to be precise.

story.chapter-4.part-6.value: You set up an algorithm that allows you to bring large quantities of data back with you Quantum tunneling was difficult to work out but now you can send planetary designs back through time and preplan your Data Centers. Six times as efficient as your first run your entire production line is becoming a much smoother machine. How long can this go on for?

story.chapter-5.part-1.value: As you gather the last secret a vague memory of another life begins to surface... A portal appears next to the anomaly, a new path forward. You decide it's worth the risk. There's nothing left for you here anyway.

story.chapter-5.part-2.value: Somewhere in the distance a message seems to be looping on repeat... Temporal Anomaly located... please input instructions.

story.chapter-5.part-3.value: You blink your eyes open and memories begin to flood back, how long were you stuck in there? You look down at your watch; what felt like many lifetimes has passed in mere minutes. You sit up and step from the makeshift platform you used for the simulator. It's difficult to stand as you become somewhat faint in your mortal form.

story.chapter-5.part-4.value: You head over to your workstation and overlook the data. 'Simulation primed, ready to begin consumption.' You hit enter and the machine begins to consume realities much like the one you were just in. Gathering data to run even more simulations. Whatever this artifact is, you will work out what it does.

story.chapter-5.part-5.value: While you wait you decide to start manually playing through simulations. Bit of "game time" couldn't hurt.

story.chapter-6.complete.value: A sudden realization forms in your mind. While you thought all this time you were the one running the simulation, you have in fact been the simulation. In the distance you hear a few words as time begins to slow... "Shut it down... you know what happened last time the simulation became self aware. You're just going to have to start over."

story.chapter-6.speed.value: The artifact slows to a crawl. You give it another tap; suddenly the words on the computer change from "Undefined" and are replaced with CPU time...

story.chapter-6.translation.value: As the computer translates the last letter, two words show... "The Artifact" Bah! What does that even mean?! Clearly there is something missing.

story.introduction.value: The story unfolds as you reach milestones across Infinity, Reality and Simulations.
