wiki.lore.existence.chapter.1.body.value:
You always had a dream, a grand dream. Of all the science fiction ideas, the Dyson swarm project
seemed the most magnificent to you, so you dedicated your entire life learning about AI and
engineering. One day like any other, after finishing an update of an idle game about sheep gathering, a
rush of technological enlightenment rushes over you, and thus you head over to a small workbench and
begin working non stop.

Your efforts bear fruits, and a small (to the height of your wrist) robot is made. 2 arms, a rotating
anchored head and some hovering device that allows it to travel seamlessly (although you don’t
understand how exactly that device works), ready to follow any orders.

After you make sure it works by instructing it to make you a sandwich, you upload some schematics
you and some other Dyson swarm enthusiasts came up with, and watch it go to work. Despite it tearing
some electronic devices that you obviously don’t care about (who needs a television when you have
computers) and using metal from not so legal sources (goodbye metal fence), the bot manages to create
the first Dyson swarm panel. After the atmospheric interference, hooking it up to your house circuit
results in a 400 W increase in energy production. For one, it ain’t bad, now to scale it even more.

You create more robots, and let them free on a local junkyard. A lot of metal, not much human
presence. The energy generation has gone up to 3 KW, and now you earn a good supply of money
selling the excess power to your power supplier. You begin to wonder, if there is a way to automate the
process of creating the robots, and an idea strikes your mind. The best creation of Ford, assembly lines.
With some tweaking, you could finally idly sit by and watch your robots replicate.

There goes all of your money, but now you have an assembly line making 1 bot every
Redacted. Slow, but requires no manual labor. You take a visit to the local
junkyard, only to find that your robots have consumed a decent chunk of the available metal and
electronics there. If they keep this up (and they will, that is what they are programmed to do),
eventually they will scrap the entire planet to make solar panels. You admit it is time to get some help.

You contact your local university, and after spending an hour trying to reach the director of science,
you briefly explain what you been doing, and ask for some help with the metal situation. At first he
laughs at you, something like this is beyond human engineering he boldly says, only to gulp when you
inform him that a group of 10 robots is heading to the university for a showcase of power. After what
could be described as a bunch of solar panels being made in front of many shocked University students
and faculty, you strike a deal with the government officials (of course they want in on this,
monetization potential is beyond any imagination) and now have the Australia’s metal and electronic
supplies at your disposal.

You were having another meeting with world leading scientists and engineers, to talk about your
growing empire. The world still doesn’t understand how you did it, but with around 5 MW of power
being generated without upkeep is more than happy to support you. You met a friendly fellow, that
works for the National AeroSpace Agency (NASA, for shorts), and he proposed a crazy idea. What if
you ignored the atmospheric interference entirely, and sent the panels into space? Using a big fat
missile would work, and it wouldn’t be that expensive with the invention of the first purely electrical
spaceship powering drive. It could work, and would definitely speed up the process, so you agree and
begin the preparations.

A month later, the first missile launches and the first 100 panels are on the way to your local star. The
plan worked perfectly, but the panels got fried by the sun’s radiation after 10 seconds of exposure. Still,
the energy production of each was tripled, definitely making up for the losses.

It was about time to take the whole process one step further. With cooperation of the Massachusetts
Institute of Technology (MIT), you developed a AI manager, that would be responsible for the
acquisition and creation of more assembly lines. They would also lead the brand new science robotic
division, and you are more than excited to see what’s going to happen. Robot count up to this point,
around 15 thousand across the globe.

It was about time you solved the current panels reaching space problem. With the approval of the UN,
you got permits to build your own space station, that would act as the first orbital factory for your
panels. You said goodbye to your loved ones and your cat, initiating blast off into SPACE. Difficult at
first, but you manage in around 6 months to make a space station the size of the International Space
Station, with a dedicated research section, a massive room for assemblies and many space docks for the
metal carrying ships. You also got your first server, responsible for programming new AI managers.
Although slow, you can feel it was worth the investment.

wiki.lore.existence.chapter.2.body.value:
At this point you have at least 60k panels active at all times orbiting the sun. Your endeavor meets 70%
of earth’s energy demands, and you can definitely see the situation down there improving. Your
scientific divisions also propelled human knowledge to new heights, and finally you won’t have to
depend on earth for metal, but dedicated AI controlled mining ships that would harvest mercury and
bring the metals back. Your space station is now much bigger, and stationed around the moon because
it was interfering with communications and light.

The empire is growing, at an almost exponential growth. Earth is finally truly dependent on reusable
forms of power generation, and you cannot help but feel proud for helping your species reach this
milestone. You now have an array of bases set on the moon, most of them for research but some
housing your brand new Data centers. Large would be an understatement, those puppies would make
even more servers, for more managers, and more assembly lines, and more bots per day. Robot count
up to this point, 7 million.

Your secret project has finally been created. You decided to start keeping some stuff secret, since the
UN doesn’t have the best track record. On the core of the moon your bots had been working non stop,
hollowing out the area and installing a state of the art particle accelerator, at least 10 times stronger
than the one on Switzerland, earth. The findings were astonishing from the first moment the reaction
started, you are certain this will help your research effort tremendously.

Great news from the scientific division, planetary colonization efforts can finally begin on Mars. Now
you know that’s where humanity planned to go, but soon enough other star systems will be accessible.
Mars will be designated as the first Scientific planet. Goal is to make more data centers, and an entire
planet has a lot of space for them. Yesterday you crossed a new milestone, 1 million panels active
around the sun. If your estimates are correct, in about a month the entire star will be encased, so you
will need to look for new ones.

Yet another breakthrough, this time from your friends down at Earth. The first Faster than Light engine
has be created and approved by the Planetary administration (following your technological progress,
society down on earth has changed significantly. Wars have been stopped, poverty has been eradicated
and the UN has officially been replaced by the Planetary administration, that consists of 500 members,
at least 1 from each country, and 1000 AI advisors that secretly report to you). You purchased the right
to recreate it, and after outfitting your entire fleet with one of those sweet marvels of physics and
engineering you send your automated scouting fleets to the nearby solar systems in hopes of finding
more stars to surround.

Mars, Uranus, Saturn and Pluto have been covered entirely by data centers, your progress is ever
increasing. A stunning report from one of your scout teams brings hope that soon each panel will last
for longer than a minute. Some unknown alloy was been found orbiting a nearby black hole, and your
scientists believe it will add around 20 seconds of lifetime to your panels. Pretty significant if it works.

wiki.lore.existence.chapter.3.body.value:
You now officially reached the end of this lore, please subscribe to our newsletter for updates… That’s
what you read this morning, finishing your favorite book about sentient avocado warriors riding
massive maine coons. Your team has been working on yet another project, called matter replicator. If it
works, you will have nigh infinite matter for your robots to turn into panels, as well as an endless
supply of avocados, and pie.

Earth has been steadily improving. Antimatter generation is finally cheap enough to be worth utilizing,
gravity manipulation has allowed for layered cities, genetic modification is finally a thing and people
are in the brisk of immortality. At long last, androids start to take over humans (in a good way. There is
a Utopian abundance on earth and people don’t need to work to survive. They can instead spend all that
time playing games, writing books and loving each other). You are especially interested on the latest
invention, it could act as a direct upgrade to your robots. So far you have engulfed 7 stars, allowing for
some ludicrous power generation and funding of previously thought insane projects. Current robots
count, Redacted.

The matter replicator is online, finally. Einstein was right, the energy requirement is insane to make a
single gram of matter, but you have 9 stars worth of energy production. One of those would be installed
in every station and factory, hopefully this will put an end to the consumption of entire planets for
matter. Those planets could be excellent for Data Centers.

It works, although it still isn’t fast enough to meet the entire matter demand of your growing empire.
But that is not what concerns you. A few days ago you crossed 10 engulfed stars, and for a single split
second you felt reality slow down, just enough for you to notice. You decide not to think much of it,
after all you are really tired lately. All of Alpha Centauri planets are now Scientific planets, and the
stars themselves completely surrounded with your solar panel swarms.

Efficiency of your matter converters has steadily improved. With more planets for research, more stats
for energy, and more avocados to eat, now a matter converter takes only 10 GigaJoules of energy to
make one gram of matter. But the progress of your matter converter is not, surprisingly, the most
important revelation this time. Aliens! You finally have an answer to the question if there is life beyond
earth, and yes, yes there is. So far you only found primitive and early space civilizations, but you are
hopeful one day an advanced xeno will come and say hello, preferably peacefully.

You now have engulfed 30 stars. Your scientists also estimate they have discovered around 30% of the
galaxy, and there is certainly room for improvement. More space civilizations are discovered each day,
some defying the current known laws of physics. On a Rocky planet you discovered silicon lifeforms,
on a star some plasma entities hall your ships and say hello, truly an exciting lifetime to live in.

wiki.lore.existence.chapter.4.body.value:
You got attacked by… something. A scientific vessel got utterly obliterated by some form of defense
array. Thankfully It seems it only protects a specific star system, but you are definitely curiously as to
why. You also now understand that you might need to weaponize some of your Dyson swarms, and
make a proper space fleet. Well, you have the resources and the technology, time to achieve pure Daka.

Daka has not been achieved, yet, but progress is made at an outstanding rate. You came up with a
design of a tiny quantum level nanobot that dissolves all form of matter and replicates itself. Now, you
made extra sure it won’t go rogue, and after some tests each nanobot can withstand a god ray™ (yet
another invention of yours. Concentrated light from one of your engulfed stars utilizing wormholes to
reach their target however far it is. After all, why limit your damage potential). You now have the
means to take down the defense array, let’s see what it is protecting.

Array converted into nanobots. It did try to protect itself, for the record, but its weapons weren’t made
for this kind of opponent. The star system is like any other, with the exception of the star itself.
Something is in the middle of it, blocking all further scans. Why must you make me destroy potential
wealth sources, oh mysterious thing?

The nanobots are better than you first anticipated. It took them 30 seconds to consume the star and
make the thing in the middle accessible, you got to make sure they don’t get out of hand, ever. Anyhow,
the thing in the middle was a prison of sorts, which is both fascinating and extremely alarming. Inside
you found odd hieroglyphics, some fragments of matter that appear completely different to that of your
own galaxy, and a person closely resembling…you.

You, well him, well the other person that looks like you, told of an interesting story. He was trapped
here, by ancient powers of untold strength, to prevent him from overpowering them. It seems this
person was on the same journey as you, slowly converting the entire galaxy into an efficient space
empire before losing everything and getting trapped inside this star for untold millennia (3 million
years to be exact. Given star coordinates that simply don’t exist today, your scientists were able to pin
point the time of imprisonment). After recovering his strength, you gave some coordinates of the
capital of those ancient powers. ‘’They must be stopped before you have the same fate as me’’, he said,
warning of impending doom. Back to the drawing board, this will require a lot of thinking, and god
knows how much firepower.

Okay, alright. Your capital ship is created, and it’s magnificent. Being powered by all of your engulfed
stars (using wormhole technology to transfer energy directly to the on board capacitors), having enough
matter converters to make planets, and utilizing reality breaking physics to move (not wormholes,
universe rewriting. You found that you can manipulate the distance of stars and things, so now each star
is a centimeter away from one another, or 20 billion light years, all up to you), this ship is more than
ready to remain forever. As for armaments, there is not a single weapon idea that hasn’t been installed.
Antimatter cannons, god rays™, nanobot dispensers, asteroid yeeters (they yeet asteroids with speeds
close and or higher than the speed of light), you name it, it is here. Now to make 68 more of those, and
you are ready for combat.

Capital ships, escorted by around 10 thousand smaller ships and a layer of nanobots covering
everything ready to convert. You cannot be more ready, so you set sail to the capital and central system
of the ancient powers, weapons ready. You arrive, and meet minimal resistance. There were 10 defense
arrays sure, but they got utterly evaporated before even firing a volley. That was underwhelming, and
you aren’t certain if you should be thankful or scared. Scans of the system will be done shortly, let’s see
what you can find.

wiki.lore.existence.chapter.5.body.value:
The ancient powers are without a doubt dead, or dormant. The star system at first glance has 12 planets,
but on closer investigation there are maybe infinite planets of size and purpose, stacked in dimensions
only the best of your instruments can take a glance into. The planets accessible all are in ruins,
completely empty without a sign of life anywhere. Thankfully, many sites worth investigating are
constantly discovered, your scientists will have work to do until next Monday, probably. You take your
armada back, and disband the fleet entirely. So much useful matter shouldn’t be wasted on things
serving no purpose, the nanobots are more than enough of a defense for now.

The first of the many sites has been excavated, and what you find is confusing. There is no indication
as to what caused the extinction event on this planet, from what your science bots could gather the
planet was booming with life until some 5 million years ago. Sadly you didn’t recover any fancy new
technologies, but you got some rather small but significant insights on this precursor extremely
advanced civilization. More science robots are storming the planet to help answer the questions
quicker, you can only wish you won’t wake some ancient evil with all the poking around.

Number of total robots, Redacted. Number of engulfed stars
Redacted. The surface level archaeology sites have all been either explored,
excavated or analyzed. The inhabitants of this planet from what you could gather were beings of pure
energy, having and simultaneously lacking a physical form. They were immortal, with reports of some
entities reaching the age of 50 thousand. Time and space meant little to them, and the rules of physics
didn’t at all apply to their infrastructure, society and weapons. Those beings were as close to gods as
something can be, which only makes things more terrifying. For a civilization of this magnitude to lose
their capital planet would mean whatever got them was swift, instantaneous and ruthless.

You got a call from the United Federation of Humanity. In one of the colonized worlds some people
found something, that looks like a big keystone. You aren’t sure what it does, but you generously
accept to keep this discovery in your trove of knowledge for the time being. Maybe you will unlock
some Ancient cache of Technology at some point, who knows.

News from your scientists, they found a massive vault in the core of a planet previously thought
destroyed by gamma radiation. Time to see if the key fits, and what treasure lays inside. You don’t
expect much in the way of danger, the radiation has been cleared and the vault brought to the surface.
Just in case you got a few nanobot clouds, just in case.

The vault was empty, well almost empty. It had something that looked like a keypad, with the following
message ascribed below it ‘’the Grandest of meanings will open the passage to what it is hidden
beyond the unknown’’. You got absolutely no idea what it means, and there is no way you can brute
force the answer. The keypad seems to be offline, with no way to power. You might need to come back
later, once you gain a bit more knowledge of the universe.

wiki.lore.existence.chapter.6.body.value:
New milestone, first complete galaxy engulfed with Dyson swarms. The milky way is now invisible to
the naked eye, with all forms of solar radiation never escaping its solar system. In a feat of power,
intelligence and efficiency you attract the nearest galaxy to a distance pre FTL ships could approach,
and continue expanding your solar panel empire across there. You actually begin to wonder if there is a
hard limit, or you will continue expanding until you cover all of reality with panels. One way to find
out, more panels needed.

The entirety of the ancient civilization’s capital has been explored atom by atom. As per usual the
deeper you ventured in the planet the more complex things you found. The civilization called
themselves the stabilizers and worshiped or better conversed with an even more advanced being called
Avoca… something. What is most fascinating is their dimension adjusted worlds. According to a
frequency message (they communicate via frequency transmission, well they were beings of pure
energy), for other beings to access them a ‘’prestige point’’ was required. What even is a ‘’prestige
point’’, this sounds a lot like an idle game you used to play back then.

In all honesty, you expected more discoveries considering you can engulf entire galaxies in months.
Not exactly better technology (you start to feel that the technological limit are closing in on your rather
rapidly), but interesting civilizations, anything to put in your books to read again in the future. Sure,
there were some advanced civilizations like the cuboids that tried to convert entire galaxies into energy
only to use to power some tesseract (only to be squished by your armadas and have the artifact seized
by force), but nothing extraordinary. Though, you are an empire spawning several galaxies and still
growing exponentially stronger, there might always be a bigger fish but it will be progressively harder
to find.

You done it again. You constructed, after many resources, Avocado salads and energy a galaxy sized
super computer. The name matrioshka brain would be a fine candidate, but you prefer the ‘’BIG
BRAIN’’ instead. The computing power is immense, and because of extremely advanced technologies
it improves itself in an exponential manner. The entirety of the human race was transported to it, and
they now live in a perfect for everyone virtual world, free of physical limitations and needs (and out of
the way. Humanity always ends up ruining things).

wiki.lore.existence.chapter.7.body.value:
Number of bots, Redacted . Engulfed galaxies, Redacted .
At this point you are waiting for something to happen. Scientific exploration yields no result, your self
trapped in the star only advises you to get even more robots. Have you reached the limit, Is this it?
Well, whatever, you instructed your robots to begin preparations of the final and grandest project,
nicknamed ‘’Linnéa’’ in honor of Carolus Linnaeus (one of the greatest scientists of Humanity, and
revolutionary in the field of natural exploration). It would be a display of all forms of life, matter,
energy, everything that can be cataloged and displayed. Even with your untold numbers of mechanical
followers, something like this will take a long time, but you got nothing better to do.

Number of robots, Redacted . Engulfed galaxies, Redacted .
Project ‘’Linnéa’’ is half completed. The infrastructure is finished, specimen gathering is going well,
hopefully it will be worth the trouble. When you reach this scale of power, life becomes rather boring.
You were never married, for the sake of efficiency, and 250 years spent alone without love and sincere
interaction really withered you. Worse come to worse, there is always more room in BIG BRAIN for
you, and finding eternal love has never been easier.

Something happened, something actually happened. Yesterday you crossed the 100 quadrillion robotic
followers milestone, and reality slowed down for a bit. Maybe a couple of seconds, but enough for you
to notice. You have some theories as to what this might mean, but to get any answers only one thing
needs to be done, get more robots.

Your grandest of projects, the epitome of science and exploration, had been completed. Project Linnéa
is now open to all to explore (virtually, no physical interaction is allowed to not disturb some of the
exhibit), and to your knowledge you have one of all (and all of one in some cases). You can rest assured
you found anything and everything, not that you are planning on resting. There is still more things to be
found, more mysteries to uncover.

As of today, you have 4.2 Quintillion robots. You wonder why that is the number that triggered the
event, but it sure did something. That something was a sub frequency everywhere on the universe,
‘’warning, collapse imminent’’. If this means what you think it means, time to back-up this universe in
a virtual dimension. A simulation within a simulation, if your theories are correct. Time will tell, more
robots are required.

You were admiring project Linnéa for one last time, and more specifically the human compartment. Its
history right before your eyes, from the stone tools and cave dwelling to controlling galaxies.
Absolutely magnificent, and it is all thanks to you. It is a shame all this would go to waste, but for what
is worth you did your best with what you got (literally everything).

wiki.lore.infinity-achieved.chapter.1.bo.value:
42 Quintillion robots, the breaking point. Reality slowed down for around 5 hours, enough for a ‘’hard
reset’’ to happen. It wasn’t joking when it said collapse imminent, you woke up in your bench
constructing your first robot. Although the previous universe is now gone (maybe the virtual backup
survived?), you will now reach new heights faster, thanks to your experience. You do feel something is
different this time around, but you can’t pin point exactly what. Time will tell, for now you need to
construct more robots.

Living exactly the same life with the full experience of the previous one sure makes things easy, albeit
boring. It took you far less time to engulf the sun, since you knew exactly what to do and how. You also
pin pointed what was different, your assembly lines works at twice the speed. Not certain why, chances
are after everything got reset maybe a value changed or something broke. It benefits you, so you cannot
complain.

This time you rushed the star system of the ancient civilization. Although you didn’t develop the
technology so much, you still easily overcame the defense array, but sadly nothing changed. 80 years
didn’t unfortunately made much of a difference, but you are still hopeful one day you will find answers
to what is inside the vault, and maybe access the other planets on the higher dimensions.

Sadly, not much is different this time around. Sure it is much faster to make robots and in turn panels,
but there are no new mysteries to uncover, nothing else to do. Project Linnéa 2.0 is under construction,
you have engulfed galaxies already and your empire focuses much more on planets. Yet you feel that
something is missing, the question is what.

wiki.lore.infinity-achieved.chapter.2.bo.value:
A revelation came to you while you were eating an avocado salad. You purposely halted your robot
production, you already have a Quintillion of them, reality is against slowing down, yet you haven’t
found an answer to the main question (did anything else change from the reset). Alongside your project
to store all forms of life and matter, project that quickly got finished because you knew where to look
for everything, you also begun the project you like to call ‘’eye of the cosmos’’. Basically, it will track
down all values of the universe you can access, store them and then upload them to your consciousness.
That way, when the next reset happens you will know if anything did change. Let’s just hope nothing
goes wrong with the upload.

Second reality break has been achieved. Project eye of the cosmos was successful, first thing you did
when you woke up was to upload all the information in your computer. Yes, it took around 3 days and
more storage drives than an actual server complex, but everything is stored for when you set the project
up again for direct comparison. The only apparent difference this time is that your assembly lines AND
your managers work 4 times faster. Yep, this definitely feels like an idle game. Still, you benefit from it
so no complains there.

Because you were bored you developed the ultimate enemy, a nigh immortal self replicating cloud of
cake. Then you commanded your nanobot swarms to contain it, and observed the fight. It took quite a
lot of time, but eventually the nanobots ate the last piece of cake before returning to Idle mode. You
guess that indeed, the cake is a lie, before returning to the grand overseeing of your empire. The three
main projects (BIG BRAIN, Linnéa and eye of the cosmos) are all almost finished, and you cannot help
but feel excited, after around 150 years doing nothing other than living the same exact life with some
minor changes for variety.

Congratulations, you have found the answer. That is what you thought to yourself after finishing the
comparison of the data from eye of the cosmos 1.0 and eye of the cosmos 2.0. There were exactly 3
changes from one reality to the next. First, the increase of the so called infinity multiplier from 4 times
to 8 times. Secondly, the fact that the infinity multiplier now affects servers. Thirdly, a small pocket of
space in a galaxy far far away has been changed to what appears to be a shop. You are heading there
right now, let’s hope it will be worth your time.

wiki.lore.infinity-achieved.chapter.3.bo.value:
The shop owner was an orange amorphous slime of medium dimensions. Not certain why but being
near it caused you great euphoria, maybe some pseudo psychology effect for finally getting answers
[this is a reference to scp 999. Love the lil guy too much to not include him]. Although it didn’t speak
with words, it explained to you that a new resource is now accessible to you, called infinity points.
Alright, now you know first hand how Idle Sun flock feels like, exciting (?). The slime friend, that calls
himself jiggly opened a catalog in which you could spend your Infinity Points (IP for short). Many
goodies could be acquired in exchange for literally an entire reality, the main ones being automation
forms, reality tweaking to start out in a later stage of your star engulfing journey, extra skills (maybe
you will finally get good at foreign languages) and finally a secret, that is universal and hidden to all
except you. Intriguing, but you cannot get them all right now unfortunately.

You are happy that now you know the purpose of the reality breaks (quite the achievement, not certain
how many people can say they broke the entire reality for personal gain, good job you), but there is still
no sign of the ‘’prestige points’’ needed to unlock higher adjusted worlds of the ancient civilization. Oh
and about the padlock on the ancient Vault, nothing actually changed, so the universal secret is not tied
to it, not yet that is. Time will tell.

3rd reality break, fourth reality you will eventually engulf in its entirety. It is rather tragic, the very
definition of a human, to sacrifice that many things in the quest of knowledge. You have (had, will
have?) friends, a romantic interest, and although you can reliably save them into BIG BRAIN, they'll
eventually all get reset to their previous forms without any memories of what happened. More food for
thoughts, but you encountered a problem that only existed in video games, the interaction of the player
with NPC entities. No matter how advanced, they will always lack a greater meaning…

Your current record for reality break is 30 years. Not certain with who you are comparing at this point,
it’s not like there is a grand multidimensional league of entities that observe your every move. The
main projects of your empire get completed at least 10 times faster than the previous reality, and you
have spent a great deal of time thinking of the next big project. But…nothing strikes you as important.
You found everything there is to found, no other universes exist to explore, the only thing left to do is
grind more reality breaks in hopes of finding some form of answers, any form would be better than
nothing.

The fifth reality break has been achieved, hooray for you. Everything is working at an outstanding
pace, for once you are the actual bottleneck. Perhaps getting more automation from jiggly or starting
later in your journey will help. You decided to take a breather, a vacation of sorts, from your reality
breaking adventure, and come back later ever stronger. 50 years of cryo sleep, here we come.

That was exactly what you needed. A 50 year nap to rest both the body and the soul. After waking up
you are surprised to see that nothing actually changed. Some black holes increased in size, BIG BRAIN
became significantly faster and efficient, project Linnéa is all fine and dandy. Back to work then, with
the sixth reality break.

wiki.lore.infinity-achieved.chapter.4.bo.value:
In all honesty, nothing changed between the sixth and the tenth reality break. Fastest reality time is now
20 years instead of 30, soon enough you will break reality before a human can reach adulthood, which
is good (the faster you do it, the less human NPCs you have to sacrifice). When you got the 10th
infinity point, something did happen. Jiggly was ecstatic, because you could actually uncover the first
secret of the universe word. Not certain if you want to do it yet, definitely a possibility. Still, what does
each letter do? If only there was a guide in something related to disharmony to help you [reference to
discord and #secrets of the universe]

Alright, you unlocked the first word of the universal secret. It is what a great actor and singer described
as ‘’where’s it at’’. Love, just love. Not love for wealth, social prestige or other benefits, pure love
towards someone or something. Definitely didn’t expect to find something so human in a literal
universal secret maybe you and jiggly only know about, guess that means love is indeed a universal
language all beings are capable of understanding. Truly fascinating.

Second word down, or uncovered in your case. It is family, which makes sense. Love and family go
together, in many instances one gives birth to the other. Now that you think about it, everything in this
universe is a part of a greater family. Planets are part of a solar system family, stars are family with one
another and form galaxies. Even as something as basic as a piece of dust is linked to another and all
because it is made of matter (unless it is made of antimatter or other forms of matter, then it is a part of
the matter type family it is made out off). And, as someone much more wise than you once said, “you
don’t turn your back on family”, you will find what is the greater purpose of all of this or…die trying
(can you actually die, hmm).

Well this is just ridiculous. You are not quite sure what caused the sudden speed increase, but every
reality break takes maximum 13 years. Unlucky number, but on average it is closer to 10 years. You
should be reaching a hard wall at some point, it’s not like you can reach a Point that reality breaks take
one day, right…right?

Third word of the universal secret has been uncovered. It is the word and. Outstanding revelation, you
are flowing with excitement. Well, what else will you use your Infinity Points on other than uncovering
the secret of the universe. There is apparently only one more word left, and it is a big one. More reality
breaks it is.

Fascinating. Today you bought the final word of the universal secret, and many things happened. First,
you revealed that the universal secret is Love, Family and incrementals. Secondly, jiggly is out of
things to sell you, and seems rather sad. Thirdly, why incrementals? Okay sure they are enjoyable and a
great way to waste some time, but seriously. Better not be some joke from a fedora wearing developer
somewhere in the multiverse. Lastly, you finally might have what it takes to open that vault that has
been taunting you since the first reality.

wiki.lore.infinity-achieved.chapter.5.bo.value:
Because you can never be overly defended, you brought your entire armada, galaxies worth of
nanoclouds and the elite of the elite genetically improved avocado soldiers to the vault. You fitted all
that by manipulating the space variable in the room and adding a couple of zeros to the diameter. The
padlock was there, the sentence was there, time to find out if a universal secret is enough to uncover the
greatest mystery so far.

Well that was a big waste of fuel and time. Haha, gotcha (you got to understand that even the narrator
gets tired after a while), it was totally worth it. Inserting the phrase indeed opened the vault, and inside
there were two pills. The left one, blue in color, had written on its capsule fullwake. The right one,
turquoise in color, had the word upside written on it. Not certain what to do with them, you placed
them on a high security storage box and ventured back to jiggly, hoping it has some answers.

‘’which one would you pick player, the Blue one or the turquoise one’’ jiggly said. It could speak
English just fine, not sure how since it lacks any form of vocal cords but it manages very well spoken
English. When it comes down to choosing between one or the other, there is only one correct answer.
Pick half of each option (2/2=1) and go from there. You decided to consume the wake part of the blue
pill and the up part of the turquoise pill, since it made sense to you (although full side sounds fun, oh
the monstrosity that is choosing), down the hatch they go.

You have awoken, to a place made of light. Is this heaven, have you finally escaped the simulation. A
gentle touch to your shoulder forces you to turn around, only to see a version of you almost perfectly
identical. ‘’Welcome’’, it says, ‘’to the realm of the prestiged. Congratulations on your journey so far,
I’m afraid you only have scratched the surface of this whole mystery. Come, let me show you around,
there are lots that need to be done’’. Having nothing to lose and much to gain, you decide to follow
your almost perfect clone, observing the surrounding land as slowly the light dissipates and an endless
field of more you’s appears.

‘’We call this place the multiverse station, for people across all kinds of universes end up here. We
aren’t sure what brought us here, but we all share the same task. You see this’’ the figure pointing to a
small sphere. ‘’That is your task, you need to make sure the civilization in there reaches the greatest of
their possibilities, by gently guiding it and improving their odds’’. You take a hold of the sphere, but of
course you immediately drop it on the floor. ‘’Not the first one that is clumsy, we expected this
outcome long before it happened. Here, pick it up again’’. With more care this time you pick up the
sphere, and spot a stone age humanity in it. A simulation within the simulation you think to yourself,
and it is your turn to play god. ‘’best of luck to you my friend. May your quest bring answers, for all
we desperately need them. Remain vigilant, remain safe’’. That was the last you heard of your similar
clone like figure, before it blinked out of your vision. You are certain it is there, watching your every
move, so let’s us not waste any more time, there is a humanity in need of guidance.

Ad Astra my friend, ever onward.

wiki.lore.introduction.value: The original Wiki chronicle. These chapters are separate from the interactive Story destination.

wiki.lore.reality.chapter.1.body.value:
‘’In the endless expanse of the cosmos, bright spheres of hope rise and fade’’

It has been a good while since the last time, time holds no value in the multiverse station, still you can
feel it flowing, all ever changing. Playing God is difficult, but after many attempts (and countless
humanities going extinct), you finally understood the basics of civilization management.

You can influence your universe, be it to a tiny extent. Humanity was truly stupid when it started, not
even thinking of hunting and farming without the guidance of a higher…deity? Considering what you
are and what you went through, it is fair to assume you are god, just a different form of God, a deus ex
machina if you wish. You manage to guide small communities of humans into forming and making
houses, but every time an asteroid strikes the planet, wiping all life including humanity off it. But, with
each strike your knowledge increases, and soon enough you might be able to do something about that
asteroid.

Attempting to contact other yous didn’t achieve much, for all were in discord. Speaking gibberish, but
then again you might be speaking gibberish to them. Might very well be a limitation of the greater
simulation, or a way to prevent new ‘’gods’’ quickly finishing their task. Regarding your task, great
progress has been achieved.

It took a lot more humanities, but you finally managed to prevent the asteroid from crashing into planet
H32. Like a programmer in your world would remove a string of code that ruins the project, you
manipulated asteroids with dangerous trajectories to planet alpha homonic to no longer exist, and it
worked. It took a great amount of power from you, but at last humanity won’t die from a random space
rock.

From your view point, humanity advances extremely fast. Cities started to form, the industrial
revolution allowed for the first factories and humanity could manufacture rockets to launch into orbit.
Spending some of your power allows you to accelerate the progress up to 10 times, yet a new crisis has
appeared. AI overlords, a concept that was avoided in your case because of a simple fix (you just coded
AI to only want 2 things, help humanity and solve the question if a God actually exists. The latter
cannot be answered with technological means, so even when matrioshka brains were operational the AI
didn’t even consider enslaving humanity), prevents humanity from advancing to the next civilization
stage. Missiles very well like earth were means of transportation, and a weapon of mass destruction,
something the AI knew perfectly well and enslaved the entirety of humanity under the threat of nuclear
annihilation.

Something worth noticing is the curve of influence and power needed to manipulate a parameter in
your sphere simulation. It is harsh, to say the least, but you didn’t expect a walk through the park.
Searching for exploits and loopholes resulted in a bunch of nothingness, which means you’ll grind
many humanities until the AI threat is taken care of.

wiki.lore.reality.chapter.2.body.value:
For a God, or a god like entity, you aren’t really observant. All this time you were fiddling with the
humanity inside of the sphere, there was a big bright door with the sign above saying ‘’to universe of
origin’’. Your universe still exists, and gained progress without you. You wanted permanent
automation, and somehow you manifested it into your universe meaning you can watch the bots grow
forever.

Jiggly called you today, and by calling it appeared in your thoughts and talked with you. Apparently, it
exists in the multiverse station as well, and has something extremely important to tell you, which
requires your undivided attention and immediate Presence. Sure, that is far from the weirdest thing that
happened to you so far, let’s go find jiggly and take care of the issue.

Jiggly is big, real big. You expected to find your beloved and cute slimy friend you knew in your
universe, instead you found a being so large your brain refused to comprehend the scale of this… thing.
Tentacles tearing the fabric of the multiversal expanse, endless eyes and faces tracking you and all at
the same time, what the heck is this? It didn’t speak, but you understood perfectly well what it wanted
to say. When you unlocked the vault, what actually happened is you unlocked the second layer of the
simulation, the so called multiverse station. Similar to how breaking the simulation with 42 Quintillion
bots gave infinity points, unlocking the vault grants quantum shards (who came up with the naming
scheme, pretty cool if you ask me). Quantum shards can be utilized to manifest changes in the universe
and the multiverse, provided you have enough of them. Jiggly explained something else. The
multiverse station is far from filled with many you, on the contrary it’s completely empty. The beings
above created it as the second challenge to prove your worth.

You had many questions, so jiggly or better a face of jiggly (had infinite of those after all) began
answering them. The superiors were the creators of the simulations (emphasis on the plural), beings of
power and knowledge surpassing everything else. About the simulations, there were infinite of those,
but layered. You are in layer 2, the reality layer, about [redacted] done with the challenges. The
challenges exist for all simulated beings to prove their worth so they can one day exist outside of the
simulation, in the real world. Jiggly is, or better was, a being that passed all challenges, except the last,
for reasons it won’t explain, yet. Finally, (for now, jiggly is busy), there will be an important decision in
the future, jiggly advices you to take into consideration all the parameters and outcomes. As for the
narrator, who they are will be revealed in the future.

You aren’t sure if you got more or less questions now, but at least some things start to make sense. The
next step is clear to you, the humanity in your sphere needs to reach the Dyson age, maybe even the age
of wonders (age of wonders is the time a civilization, having secured its survival, creates mega projects
and progresses with fantastical speed), though sacrifices and gradual influence to their simulation.

wiki.lore.reality.chapter.3.body.value:
Getting rid of the AI overlords was not an easy task. The solution was sadly not as simple as in your
universe, instead you had to ‘’code’’ a parameter that prevents ai to think about enslaving humanity. It
took a good lot of influence, many humans sacrificed and a ton of strange matter, something you
discovered a bit back and never paid too much attention to it until now. Let’s see if that’s enough for
humanity to reach Dyson age.

After spending some of your ever increasing Influence, thanks to using some quantum shards to
become more influential, humanity finally made their first space factories. As of planet H32, it is
blooming into a civilization utopia. World peace has been achieved, countries trade with each in a risk
free environment, sciences advances and soon enough humanity will discover fusion, if it wasn’t for
one minor problem. The industrial process and more specifically the industrialization of space
completely ruined the environment, with climate crisis being unavoidable and humanity perishing
before making their first space colony. You know what needs to be done, but It won’t be easy to change
all industrial manners to a more ‘’eco friendly approach’’.

While waiting for enough strange matter to accumulate (ah yes, letting countless humanities die so you
can reach a certain goal, typical Friday), you decided to explore the multiverse station. It would offer
more excitement than standing over a sphere and waiting for climate change to happen, that’s for darn
sure. ‘’Start walking towards one direction and see where that takes you’’, ancient trusted strategy of
exploration.

Alright, this is straight up ludicrous. You walked no more that 10 meters from your sphere, and you
were instantly teleported back to it. Whoever made this (so called superior beings) really want you to
work on your sphere and nothing else. You know something, no, you will not be forced to do nothing.
There were 2 possible other destinations for you to spend time away from your very obvious task,
jiggly’s lair and your universe of origin. Jiggly is busy (also painstakingly scary), so back to the
universe of origin you go, back to your roots.

It certainly feels nice taking a nice relaxing vacation by the beach back on planet earth. Some time to
think, relax and wonder about your next steps is always valuable and precious, so you plan to cherish
every moment. The gold quiet sand, the splashing sapphire waves, the scorching sun, such a joyous
occasion. Your mind begins to question, if the narrator will stop talking for a moment, for they are
exceptionally annoying right now. Perhaps in time an answer will be given.

wiki.lore.reality.chapter.4.body.value:
This is the narrator, reminding you that vacation is nice and all, but you haven’t gotten anything done in
3 months. Relaxation sure feels nice, but constant avoidance of your duty is far from ideal. Don’t you
try and ignore me, you know I’m right, also for the love of God use sunscreen lotion, you are as black
as charcoal. Fine, don’t listen to me, see where that takes you.

Congratulations you idiotic savant, you died of skin cancer. Thankfully you cannot die, or better you
cannot permanently die, just respawn in your working desk, but seriously, you traveled the cosmos and
explored catastrophic events like the giga black hole back in sector 02dw3 of universal space, yet you
died from the sun, the sun. You think you are oh so smart hmmm, showing your rebellious spirit by
choosing how and where you die. You might be the biggest rebel in the universe, but also insanely
stupid. Dying achieved nothing, so I hope you are feeling better because jiggly has a message for you,
yes that jiggly, how many jigg…don’t Answer that question nevermind.

Jiggly was busy as always, so the briefing was short. All this time you were away doing extremely
productive stuff, time in the multiverse station continued to flow. But, because you weren’t allowed to
experience it, it got compressed into time hour glasses, similar to the ones used in ancient Egypt to tell
the time. This new resource, called offline time (the neat naming scheme remains) is now in your
control, okay stop playing like you knew this all along, you weren’t productive nor took a massive
break for this purpose, it just happened to benefit you this way. This is a coincidence, stop acting like
it’s providence.

Offline time really propelled you forward, it’s like you gotten 10 days worth of progress in 10 minutes.
Climate change has been permanently averted, once again capitalism was beaten with capitalism. You
just gave some insights on green supporters, altered the values of solar panels to make enough energy
for fossil fuel to be obsolete, and swapped hydrogen with xeon, much more efficient and cheaper
spaceship fuel. Now humanity has no obstacles, Dyson sphere age is now within its grasps. Will it be as
fast as your Dyson program, most likely not, but you will see.

It wasn’t faster, but at last humanity has engulfed its first star. But…you revealed something both
shockingly terrible and fascinatingly exciting. To progress in your journey for answers, you will need to
decrypt the simulation, straight up you will need to break it down to tiny pieces, and understand
everything and anything. You don’t have the infrastructure for such a project, but fear not friend, jiggly
has set up a shop in the multiverse station, selling computer parts, decryption techniques and…
hammers? In exchange jiggly asks for Strange Matter, increasing amounts of Strange Matter.

You for some reason understood with ease what needs to be done, and without the slightest hint of
remorse you collapse humanity on a black hole, netting a lot of Strange Matter, while killing trillions of
humans. I guess you are used to it, you soul thirsty monster. Since you don’t have a consciousness, I
guess you will have to do that again…excellent?

wiki.lore.reality.chapter.5.body.value:
Let me explain more about decrypting the simulation. Jiggly gave you a panel of… glass? A transparent
material in any case, that had a white line on it, just a white line. Jiggly told you that two should be the
aspects you focus on, speed reduction of the line (how does a line get slower?) and translation of the
line (translate what, a line is a straight geometrical shape with a start and sometimes end, sometimes
completely endless). It has all the necessary upgrades for your task, and if you have the matter it will
gladly give them to you. You thought to ask why it wants the matter, but jiggly answered in the same
cryptic way It did in the past ‘’the climb is endless, but not friendless. To best the expanse, help is
required’’. That is great, thank you jiggly…

The first level of translation and speed were cheap, the next one was double as expensive. One
humanity collapsing was not enough, I’m beginning to question your sanity for I can sense excitement
for collapsing more. Eh, I’m the narrator, have no actual power here. Translation required you to study
a 200 page book about ones and zeros, how many ones and zeros exist you might ask, more than 2, less
than 6259 (you figure it out, I’m getting angry with your humanity sacrifices). Speed reduction was
more elaborate, you had to use extremely strong magnets to slow the line enough to understand that it
ain’t a line, but a series of rapidly changing digits, numbers and symbols. Still, if using magnets had
such a minor effect, you begin to wonder what it will take to completely slow it down.

3 humanities sacrificed to the great black hole. Enough SM to influence a massive change in your
sphere, the invention of a fusion reactor. Thus far humanity was using solar panels to power the rail
guns required to launch Dyson panels to their proximal star, which are reliable but slow. It took a great
amount of influence to make the first fusion reactor, advanced mathematics was required to be
mastered, and for some reason you needed to prevent the cosmic well from overflowing by dropping a
ton of influence in it. I cannot explain it better, some things are still strange, but hey, if dropping a
bunch of influence down a well grants a fusion reactor I cannot complain, for fusion is much faster than
solar panels, clean as all tomatoes and reliable as the workers in the ex country Germany of your
universe.

With fusion, Dyson panels, stacked factories and all sorts of optimization, humanity reaches the Dyson
age within 2 hours from your perspective, without using offline time. That meant faster and bigger
sacrifices, to fuel your decryption efforts. Second level of the decryption upgrades were double the
price of level one, and half the price of level 3. Translation was as you anticipated another tome of 0s
and 1s, with the added digit of 01 (yes, there is 01 now, hooray). It took you only 2 weeks to read the
second tome, 3 more to memorize all of it, but you can swear some symbols of the line start making
sense to you. Speed reduction was…effective yet strange. Jiggly took your device, and yeeted in the
nearest wall, slowing it down to 9/10 of its original speed. You did wonder why you cannot repeat the
process, but a big dimensional slap to the face by jiggly was enough of an answer to not persist more.

Your sphere, the so called reality, is not an eternal loop which one might expect. Every humanity is
slightly different, and some are even fascinating. Humanity 7 for example, they created an entire cult
worshiping cats (named katt cult), under the gentle guidance of an individual named holg, a great
individual that although overly cautious was a born leader, and nuclearion, a completely chaotic entity
you had to remove from existence before it was able to take control of the global supply of nukes.
Strangely, the message ‘’time Paradox detected’’ appeared shorty after the removal, you decide to not
think about it more, most likely a random event with no importance whatsoever.

wiki.lore.reality.chapter.6.body.value:
Look at you, using your brain. You decided to fall in a Coma for a while, to let humanity accumulate
hundreds of thousands of panels for you to collapse in a black hole. Self afflicted Coma was weird to
do, considering the Cognitive effects you could experience after it (Glasgow Coma scale was rather
clear about them), but after many hits to the head by jiggly and many deaths, you managed to
completely skip 25 days from your perspective. And…it worked, humanity made around 1 million
panels, should be enough for all decryption upgrades. Does this mean you will stop sacrificing
humanities, NEVER. It’s just too fun watching their torment as they can do nothing to avoid their
repeated Armageddon.

Translation upgrade 3 was different. With all the hitting, hammering, and beating you caused to your
self trying to skip time, jiggly got an idea. What if you would get a nice shiny bat, and hit the device
with it. There was a 10% reduction in the speed the characters change, not yet enough to determine the
word(s), but an improvement. Speaking of improvements, your knowledge improved significantly after
reading characters for dummies volume 1, took only a month to completely understand but time well
spent.

Okay, because you hate the narrator you decided to bulk buy translation upgrades, thank you for that,
much appreciated. In short, translation speed 4 required a metal press squishing the device until the
atoms of the press were so compressed they exploded in a beautiful nuclear explosion (jiggly controlled
it with half a tentacle, it is a strong entity). Characters for dummies volume 2 was the next step you
mastered, after a month of head scratching and studying seemingly random stuff. Translation speed 5
was directly tied to the nuclear explosion, jiggly bombarded the device with so much radiation from all
spectrums, that you still wonder how it works and hasn’t melted. Characters for dumies volume 3 was
more head scratching, this time even jiggly offered you his words of advice, by slapping you repeatedly
when you needed rest. Overall, the speed of the characters is about half now, you can begin to
distinguish some parts of it, and a good amount of characters are completely understandable by you.
Upgrades are expensive though, which means time for more of your favorite activity.

165 sacrificed humanities later, you went to jiggly with a truck full of SM (not actually a truck, figure
of speech really). You accumulated around 10 million SM, if that ain’t enough what will. Jiggly
exchanged a decent chunk of your SM for characters for dummies volume 4, characters for dummies
final volume and universal translator. The latter included everything the previous tomes and books had,
why didn’t you buy that one first is a good question, I guess you needed to understand the previous
level of characters for it. In any case, you can now understand everything, and when I mean everything
I mean everything, even infinity. The device characters are as follows, from what you could now
determine. Three T, two A, one C, one I, one R, one F, one H and one E. There are too many
combinations still for you to determine what those might mean, more slowdown needed.

Speaking of slowdown, the next speed upgrade was extremely complicated, for it required you to use
all your brain and design an inception machine. You tell me what it does and how it works, you made it,
go ahead I insist. Characters now move at 25% the speed, that was truly a significant, and expensive,
upgrade. And then you decided it to break the fabric of reality, jumping into one of the jiggly’s portals
and ending up under 5 layers of cheese. It was extremely tasty to eat your way out, and in the process
the cheese slowed down the characters to 10% of their original step. One step remains, comprehension.

It was one thing to say it, another to do it. To comprehend the device was no easy matter, took 3 years
and lots of brainpower. But, at last, the characters in your device spell are clear to you, THE
ARTIFACT. You didn’t have time to consider what that meant, for a massive warning saying CPU
TIME appeared on the multiverse station, causing all shadows of yourself to vanish, time to slowdown
and jiggly to…jiggle? Most likely a signal the second layer is complete, now we wait for the next layer
and its secrets.

wiki.lore.reality.chapter.7.body.value:
Being so absorbed by your quest to translation, you completely forgot about your original universe. It
had accumulated hundreds of quantum shards, ready to be spent on things. 3 were the main upgrades
you chose to get, break the loop which allowed you to determine when the universe would collapse
(now you can have more than 42 Quintillion bots in your universe), quantum entanglement which
basically allows you to earn multiple quantum shards per quantum leap (unlocking the vault and
sacrificing everything for shards), and division. Division divided the amount of robots required for one
infinity point by 10 per level, and because of your genius planning you could buy 4 of them. Now it
takes only 42 quadrillion robots for one infinity point, makes you wonder how much you can divide the
amount required, will take years to find out if we are completely honest, division is expensive.

Okay, jiggly just stolen 50 quantum shards from your storage. Since when could it do that, why did it
do that, and how are questions I cannot answer, only jiggly can. You decided to be careful how to
approach this, after all a multidimensional being the scale and influence of jiggly can easily…ruin your
experience. Diplomacy is for once an option, and after some careful wording and many bows jiggly
explained why he needed the shards. Help is on the way, now that the offering was sufficient and the
lock opened. Help of what kind you tried to ask, but you were interrupted by the most beautiful,
majestic and gorgeous being imaginable. It was a cat, that looked like all cats including yours back at
earth (the cat is fine, working on a way to bring it to the multiverse station) and at the same time none.
It was avocado in shape, avocado in smell and avocado in taste (you monster, how could you). After a
short greeting and many cosmic slaps from jiggly for your unending appetite, the being introduced its
self as ‘’Avocato’’, before materializing a set of tea and gracefully drinking said tea. It was a…
gentlecat, and asked if you wanted some, which you accepted for tea helps bring down the taste of slaps
in the face.

Avocato was trapped by the superior beings for being too adorable yet powerful. With the sacrifice of
42 quantum shards, the seal was allowed to be opened, and Avocato was let free. Now, you might not
been the best at math but you know 50-42=8, where are the other shards. As Avocato soon explained,
quantum shards are the ultimate snack for multidimensional beings, and jiggly was hungry. That is truly
great, you have a massive slime thing that can eat your hard earned shards, what’s next, Avocato eating
the other resources you worked so hard to get? Curious as ever, you asked how Avocato could be of
help. Sure, it is an almighty cat god, but that doesn’t mean it is helpful. To your surprise, Avocato can
manipulate the parameters of the simulations and their layers to give you more influence, infinity
points, and strange matter. In exchange, you need to feed him increasing amounts of each resource
accordingly, why is everyone so unbelievably hungry all of the time. Eh, you got nothing better to do,
feeding an almighty cat god resources harnessed from, among other sources, human sacrifice sounds
exciting. Time to grind time, until the next expansion.

As the narrator, congratulations. You have reached what only few beings could imagine, multiversal
manipulation. There are vast challenges ahead of you, many friends to meet and things to experience.
From the bottom of my heart, ad Astra my friend, remain vigilant of the flowing time.

wiki.other.offline.value: After you have been away for at least
, that time is added to your
bank instead of being replayed automatically. Capacity starts at
. When the bank is full, you can spend it to double that capacity.

wiki.other.offline-accuracy.value: Production, automation and permanent upgrades run during replay, with at most one automation decision per update. Larger time steps can miss opportunities that shorter updates would catch, and no compensation is added for them.
is intentionally frozen while Offline Time is processing.

wiki.other.offline-processing.value: Processing advances the game through the same update system used during active play.

reduces the remaining update count and keeps the full selected duration, trading accuracy for a faster result. Cancelling safely discards the unfinished simulation and does not spend the selected Offline Time.

wiki.other.offline-results.value: A completed run reports the simulated duration, remaining bank, final accuracy and actual update count. It also shows relevant Infinity, Simulation and Reality gains. Facility and Bot gains appear only when no Infinity occurred, because a reset and rebuild would make a simple before-and-after total misleading.

wiki.other.offline-spending.value: Choose how much banked time to spend, then select
. These presets use progressively more gameplay updates. Accurate follows short-term automation more closely, while Fast completes sooner.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-1.compact-l.value: Refined Bots, Research, Simulations, Settings, Story, and Wiki layouts on compact screens with even facility gutters, tighter controls, route-specific headers, and corrected panel spacing.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-1.mega-teas.value: The next mega-structure teaser now stays hidden until mega structures are available, and both the teaser and Tinker match the facility card styling.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-1.overlays.value: Improved Avotation and Secrets interactions so their markers no longer obstruct menu or panel controls, their pop-ups remain usable, and clicking outside Secrets closes it.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-1.skills-an.value: The Skill Tree now remembers its position and zoom while switching tabs, and Manual Labour keeps Tinker anchored above facilities without covering menus or late-game panels.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-2.double-ti.value: Double Time now permanently runs all game systems at twice their normal speed.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-2.languages.value: Added complete French, German, Latin American Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Russian, and Japanese translations, with automatic selection from the device language and a manual override in Settings.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-2.offline-c.value: Added Fast, Balanced, and Accurate Offline Time presets, processing progress, Speed Up and safe cancellation, plus a completion summary after each run.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-2.processin.value: Rebuilt active and Offline Time processing around the same game simulation, improving performance while keeping permanent gains and automation consistent between updates.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-2.update-in.value: Added a Game Processing setting from 33–200 ms, allowing players to choose between more accurate automation and lower device workload.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-3.calculati.value: Added expandable calculations for changing Skill effects, including Scientific Planets and Pocket Dimensions, so their current values can be inspected.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-3.cards.value: Improved Facility and Mega-Structure cards with highlighted production values and single-line rates that stay readable on smaller screens.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-3.details.value: Redesigned Facility and Mega-Structure Details with a clearer step-by-step production breakdown covering purchase bonuses, Research, Skills, dynamic effects, and game speed.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-3.statistic.value: Removed the Offline Time usage section from Statistics.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-3.tinker.value: Manual Labour Tinker now starts continuous production after a long press and stops when you tap elsewhere or leave the Bots tab.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-4.simulatio.value: Dyson Panels, Swarm Panels, Strange Matter, Black Hole rewards, and related statistics can now grow beyond the former 9.22 quintillion limit.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-4.stored-ti.value: Stored Time capacity no longer resets to one day after large upgrades or save transfers, and can now keep doubling without a gameplay cap.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-5.avocato.value: Refined Reality and Avocato layouts and made feeding precision-aware, so Feed All leaves behind any amount that cannot be credited safely instead of silently destroying it.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-5.facilitie.value: Facilities and their Research now follow permanent progression unlocks. Mega-Structures continue the normal facility grid, include production progress, and reveal their automation and Research as each one is unlocked.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-5.number-in.value: Debug amount fields now understand the game’s full Standard suffix vocabulary, including flexible forms such as 100 Qi, 100xQi, and 100 × qi, with separate continuous and whole-number caps.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-5.persisten.value: Fixed route restoration and progression boundaries so reloads return to the correct available tab without exposing locked Skills, Infinity, Debug, or late-game content.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-5.prestige-.value: Standardized Infinity and Quantum upgrade cards, purchase states, and settings. Both shops can hide maxed upgrades, and Infinity unlocks as soon as the first reset becomes available.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-5.reality.value: Influence and Strange Matter now use the same expanded continuous-number system as other large resources. Automatic Influence gathering is continuous and preserves generated workers when floating-point precision becomes limited.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-5.responsiv.value: Reworked Settings, navigation, Store offers, dialogs, bottom panels, and safe-area handling to use space more cleanly without clipping or oversized controls.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-5.simulatio.value: Added shallow batch-based cost scaling to Hunters, Gatherers, Solar Panels, and Fusion Generators so Buy Max remains useful at extreme values without creating effectively unlimited purchases.

Restored Railgun and Space Factory scaling, corrected volley and completed-research displays, kept Black Hole resets usable at the resource cap, and fixed a timer edge case that could stop game processing.
Redesigned Simulations and Reality upgrade sections with clearer era colours, compact completed research, restored purchase settings, and an option to show formulas directly on facility cards.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-5.skills.value: Improved Skill Presets, search controls, dialogs, assignment settings, and navigation badges. Unassigned Skill Points are now shown as whole numbers and empty badges stay hidden.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1-5.visual-sy.value: Refined the entire interface with more consistent text sizes, spacing, borders, panel density, and route colours across phones, tablets, and wide screens.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.audio.value: Added a soundtrack and interface sounds across supported platforms, with separate Music and Effects volume controls, Mute All Audio, and more reliable playback when switching apps or browser windows.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.dyson-visua.value: Improved Dyson visualization performance during extremely fast automatic Infinity runs by settling on the final galaxy field, while restoring the growing galaxy’s dense spiral, bright core, and balanced mobile placement.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.economy.value: Fixed purchases at the largest supported resource values and prevented extreme Assembly Megalines prices from becoming stuck at a reusable plateau.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.infinity.value: Expanded Infinity with manual resets independent of Auto Infinity, exact automatic Infinity Point targets, and current and peak IP-per-minute guidance.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.mobile-ui.value: Restored late-game mega structures and refreshed gameplay layouts with clearer facility cards, consistent route themes, safer mobile spacing, improved dialogs, and better compact-screen controls.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.navigation.value: Added customizable bottom navigation shortcuts with an optional Include Text setting and automatic sizing that keeps selected destinations accessible across different screen widths.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.progress-pa.value: Added shared progress and settings panels across Bots, Research, Skills, Infinity, Simulations, and Quantum, including clearer production comparisons and first-run manual Infinity controls.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.saves.value: Improved older Unity-save migration and save reliability through backgrounding, suspension, reloads, offline startup, and updates, with restored application branding and loading screens.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.settings.value: Added device-local Standard, Scientific, and Engineering number notation with stable-width gameplay digits, plus a setting to hide completed Research.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.skill-contr.value: Improved Skills presets and confirmations: locked Skills remain queued until their progression line is unlocked, production changes are previewed more clearly, and preset, reset, search, touch, and drag controls are easier to use.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.skill-effec.value: Corrected Skill effects across timer-based, offline, manual-purchase, Fragment, Purity, Terra, and Stellar branches so their bonuses, trade-offs, and unlock rules now behave as described.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.statistics.value: Expanded Statistics with the full Dyson Swarm scale and detailed performance for the ten most recent Infinity runs, including automatic and manual runs, rewards, durations, averages, medians, and ranges.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.store.value: Added the Supporter Cat Gallery for verified supporters and an Enabled/Disabled control for the owned Double Infinity Points upgrade without affecting ownership or restore eligibility.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4-1.stored-time.value: Improved Stored Time so duplicate or overlapping spends are safely rejected, active jobs retain their progress and cancellation controls, and unfinished settings remain intact when changing pages.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.accessibility.value: Improved keyboard and screen-reader support, reduced-motion behavior, mobile text selection, text-field editing, focus handling, and rapid-touch protection.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.interaction-f.value: Improved Tinker hold-to-repeat feedback, corrected Dyson and late-game animations, and fixed several stalled or unsafe automation edge cases.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.offline-time.value: Improved Offline Time with Stored Time and Double Time support, visible processing progress, cancellation, safer recovery, remembered controls, and a storage meter in navigation.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.pwa.value: The Web game can be installed as an app, reopened without a network connection, and updated through a prompt that protects progress before applying the new version.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.responsive-ui.value: Redesigned the interface for desktop, portrait mobile, and compact landscape with touch-friendly controls, safe-area support, themed navigation, and evolving star and galaxy visuals.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.saves.value: Added durable browser saves with three rotating backups, automatic recovery from the newest valid backup, regular safety checkpoints, and save protection before reloading.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.settings-and-.value: Expanded Settings save controls and improved development options with a working unlock toggle and remembered Debug and Offline Time values between tab switches.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.statistics.value: Refined Statistics with reached-system disclosure, combined Infinity totals, simulated time in each history heading, and a dedicated presentation instead of desktop-menu diagnostics.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.store.value: Added a Web Store with five support and permanent-upgrade products, Stripe checkout, and clear warnings that Web purchases belong to this browser and device rather than an account.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.story-and-sto.value: Refined Story and Store presentation with clearer sections and fewer redundant layered panels.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.transfers.value: Added preview-first save import and export, including supported Unity saves, while keeping purchases and device-specific preferences on their original device.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.web-release.value: Idle Dyson Swarm is now available to play on the Web.

wiki.patch-notes.version-4.wiki.value: Expanded the Wiki with original lore, gameplay reference material, value highlighting, topic links, remembered navigation, mobile topic selection, and unlock-aware lore sections.
